title: What AI Medical Interpretation Costs
summary: Learn what AI medical interpretation really costs, including pricing models, usage, implementation, devices, integrations, staff time.
body_markdown:
###


Pricing varies by vendor and may be based on minutes, encounters, users, sites, subscriptions, or enterprise contracts. Buyers should compare total cost of use instead of one listed rate.


###


It can be, especially when connection time, short interactions, or high usage matter, but the answer depends on software fees, usage, implementation, fallback coverage, and the current phone-interpreter contract.


###


Include implementation, devices, integration, staff setup time, support, failed sessions, and any human interpreter service that remains as fallback.


###


Cost per successfully supported encounter is often more useful than per-minute price because it includes whether the patient actually received language support.


###


Yes. Staff setup and waiting time are part of total cost, but time saved should be labeled as capacity unless it produces a real budget reduction.
